'''Sub-PAC''' is a [[Facilities|facility]] [[item]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|The AIC Factory shall connect one node to the next in order to expand into the uninhabited frontiers.}}
==Usage==
A secondary core facility that can supply power to various facilities and industrial processes. It must have an electrical connection to the main PAC to function.
==Acquisition==
Special Asset: Endfield Industries
